caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair features a dark brown wood finish with a curved backrest and Queen Anne-style legs, which are joined by horizontal stretchers near the bottom. The backrest has a vase-shaped central splat. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a light blue fabric with a subtle floral pattern that includes some yellowish accents or embroidery. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition, and a simple rectangular border is drawn around the chair. The artist's signature, “H. GRINNELL,” appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Side Chair
